summary: Connect custody event records to fund accounting, NAV checks and client reporting. Explore the five-day corporate actions course.
lede: The corporate action life cycle tracks an issuer or security-level event from notice through investor allocation and fund-book reconciliation. For custody operations and fund accounting professionals, this training builds practical controls for validating notices and positions, tracking elections, tracing cash and securities postings, and reconciling NAV differences.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who handle corporate action notices, investor elections, custody positions, fund books, or the reporting that connects them. It is designed for practitioners with working exposure to securities operations or fund administration who need more consistent controls across those hand-offs.
modules: SWIFT Notice Controls for Custody Teams
Fund Ledger Posting and NAV Bridges
prerequisites: Working knowledge of securities operations, custody processing, or fund administration is expected. Familiarity with basic fund accounting entries and investment event terminology will help you apply the case exercises.
